body.html:
There is often confusion on the restrictions for the .45 caliber "service pistol" as designated in the NRA rules for CMP (or EIC) Matches. The following information answers commonly asked questions relating to hardball guns.

This information was distributed at Camp Perry a couple of years ago. It was prepared by Michael W. Rose of the DCM. Its intent is to clarify AR 920-30, the Army Regulation that applies to Leg matches.

GENERAL RESTRICTIONS:
  • Trigger pull must be at least 4 lbs.
  • Grips, right and left, must be "mirror image" no thumb rest.
  • Pachmayr style wrap around grips are legal as long as they do not have finger grooves.

ADDITIONAL RESTRICTIONS:

LEGAL ITEMS ILLEGAL ITEMS
Extended Triggers Allen head or torx head grip screws
Adjustable Triggers Ambidextrous Safety
Vented Triggers Beavertail Grip Safety
Trigger Shoes Combat style hammer
Bright Finish Covered Mainspring Housing
Colt "Gold Cup" (no illegal items) Extended Magazine Release
Front Strap Stippled Extended Magazine Well Funnel
Gold Cup Dimple Extended Slide Stop
Lowered Ejection Port Extended Thumb Safety
Rear Sight "Melted" into Slide Magazine Base Pads
  Ribs
